largest_category_gaps.explanation: FLA chunk kernels keep more GDN intermediate work fused, and torch.compile fuses surrounding layout/elementwise operations. Dew's GDN alone has 127.448 ms of transposes/copies; the entire reference copies/layout/slicing category takes 79.801 ms. Remaining reference aten::copy_ launches on [8,6144,3072] and [8,3072,16,128] take 31.862 ms and 11.759 ms.

FLA folds GDN rule matrix work into chunk kernels: chunk_gated_delta_rule_fwd_kkt_solve_kernel (4.707 ms), chunk_bwd_kernel_dqkwg (24.711 ms), prepare_wy_repr_bwd_kernel (13.773 ms). This is a fusion/algorithm difference, not faster general GEMMs: reference MLP GEMMs take 164.212 ms versus Dew's 147.641 ms.

FLA chunk/gated-normalization kernels and Liger fused kernels reduce standalone launches. FLA l2norm forward/backward account for 10.376 ms of the reference's remaining standalone reductions. Dew has 40.132 ms of GDN reductions and 36.406 ms of source-unattributed reductions; the precise cause of all saved reduction time cannot be assigned.

caveats: Qwen3.5-0.8B measured total includes Clef. Qwen3.5-0.8B backbone is a subtraction estimate, not a matched measured step; removing the head changes backward, optimizer, fusion and scheduling.
HF uses synthetic unpadded rows and a negligible hidden-state loss; Qwen3.5-0.8B used right-padded Clef rows. This is a backbone comparison, not objective or gradient parity.

Steady metrics use 200 unprofiled steps. Categories and idle use a separate five-step tail, with a 651.821 ms profile window versus 646.632 ms steady median. Category gaps are not normalized or added to steady timings.
Memory is GiB: Qwen3.5-0.8B is an XLA/device high-water mark, reference is torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated. Allocator reserved memory is also recorded; no matched head-free Qwen3.5-0.8B peak exists.

Fusion moves work between categories. These explanations follow kernel/launch evidence, not isolated ablations. Projection GEMMs combine GDN and attention when shapes do not uniquely identify their owner; the optimizer estimate retains the available whole-step optimizer attribution.
Final categories re-reduce the unchanged trace with shared clone/cat layout rules. Raw captured attribution predates this correction; timing and memory are unchanged.
